title: Add a menu item (Toast Web) and reach the POS via Publish
summary: Create the item under Menus, attach modifier groups, then the mandatory Save → Publish all changes cycle — unpublished edits never reach the POS.

steps.title: Create the item on the workbench
Create the item in Toast Web and attach modifier groups
steps.instructions: Toast Web > Menus > Groups & items > Add item. Set name/price, choose the menu group, and attach the modifier groups this item needs. A new item with no attached groups will order without prompts.

steps.title: Save, then Publish all changes
steps.instructions: Click Save, then Publish all changes — edits do NOT reach the POS or third-party channels until published.
